title: This Manual sweeper works great on carpets
text:
This Manual sweeper works great on carpets. This Manual sweeper works great on carpets, not so well on hard floors. It doesn't pick up anything on floors.

It will make your carpet look like it was just vacuumed (of course it wasn't so dirt is still deep down in it).

I recommend this for rugs and carpet, but not hard floors.

The design on it is cute. Gotta love London.

product_metadata.title: Bissell 2205 City Sweep Manual Sweeper, London Edition
features: Perfect for quick and convenient cleaning of small messes and daily dirt
Cordless cleaning that’s always ready to go
Lightweight, quiet and easy to use
Multi-surface cleaning on rugs, carpets, and hard floors
description: With its unique skyline design, this manual sweeper is a fun and easy solution to quick pick-up needs and offers a great value to consumers of all ages.
